name: India

flag.description: Three equal horizontal bands of saffron, white and green, with a navy-blue wheel of 24 spokes (the Ashoka Chakra) in the centre of the white band.
flag.symbolism: Saffron represents courage and sacrifice, white truth and peace, and green faith and fertility; the chakra is the wheel of dharma (law and righteousness).

hook: India is saffron-white-green with a navy 24-spoke wheel in the middle; Niger has an orange disc instead, and Ireland's and Côte d'Ivoire's stripes run vertically.
trivia: The chakra is taken from the Lion Capital of Ashoka at Sarnath, a sculpture from the 3rd century BC.
The flag is known as the Tiranga ("tricolour") and is based on a design by Pingali Venkayya.
